मिव (इ) मिवि r. 1st cl. (मिन्वति)
 1. To sprinkle or moisten.
 2. (According
to some authorities,) To serve, to gratify by service.

मीवा f. (-वा)
 1. The worm of the intestines, Ascarides, &c.
 2. Air,
wind.
 E. मी to hurt, Unādi aff. वा ।

मीव् r. 1st cl. (मीवति)
 1. To be large or corpulent.
 2. To go, to move.

मीवन् m. (-वा) Air, wind.
 E. मी to move, वन् Unādi aff.

मीवर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Mischievous, hurting, killing.
 m. (-रः) The leader
of an army.
 E. मी to hurt or kill, ष्वरच् Unādi aff.
